defect_classes.name: x-workspace-id header reads as authoritative workspace identity
defect_classes.fix_description: Introduced ClaimedWorkspaceId/VerifiedWorkspaceId branded types. Header reads now typed ClaimedWorkspaceId, preventing use as authoritative identity without DB verification. asVerifiedWorkspaceId() restricted to canonical-route-enforcement (DC-16 gate).
defect_classes.recurrence_risk: HIGH — gate not in CI; fix not on main
defect_classes.denominator: 8 files reading x-workspace-id header (all allowlisted DC-01)

defect_classes.name: requireWorkspaceContext from session-reading context.ts used as workspace authority
defect_classes.fix_description: Removed all callers of requireWorkspaceContext from operator/store.ts, metrics routes, and other callers. context.ts file still exists as orphan (no external callers remain); DC-02 gate prevents NEW callers.
defect_classes.recurrence_risk: MEDIUM — context.ts is callable; gate not in CI
defect_classes.residual_risk: src/services/workspace/context.ts still exports requireWorkspaceContext — callable if someone imports it. Orphan file, no callers. Deletion would remove the risk entirely.

defect_classes.name: Non-canonical auth wrappers (withEnforcementFull, enforceWorkspaceScoping, withAuth) in route files
defect_classes.fix_description: Migrated all routes (decisions/*, experiments/*, metrics/*, governance/*, etc.) from legacy wrappers to withCanonicalEnforcement. 311 of 338 routes now use canonical enforcement. 27 routes legitimately excluded (pre-auth, health, internal, ops, stripe webhook).
defect_classes.recurrence_risk: HIGH — gate not in CI; fix not on main

defect_classes.name: Client-supplied actor identity fields persisted as authoritative
defect_classes.fix_description: DC-04 gate detects body.(approvedBy|rejectedBy|consentBy|...) reads in route files. No instances found at gate installation; gate prevents future introductions.
defect_classes.denominator: 0 active violations; gate prevents new ones

defect_classes.name: Direct db.auditEvent.create outside approved paths
defect_classes.fix_description: Allowlist narrowed to canonical callers: src/infra/audit.ts, generated Prisma models, and 4 service files with specific audit requirements. All other direct audit.create calls removed.

defect_classes.name: logAuditEvent usage (deleted legacy audit function)
defect_classes.fix_description: Migrated all 19 production callers of logAuditEvent to canonical emitAuditEvent. Legacy src/services/audit/audit-log.ts module deleted. 23 typed event name constants added to AUDIT_EVENTS.
defect_classes.recurrence_risk: MEDIUM — file deleted; gate prevents re-import

defect_classes.name: State-transition maps outside authoritative state machine files
defect_classes.fix_description: Fixed proof/review route accepting body.requiredPermission (client-controlled permission elevation). DC-15 gate added as proof. DC-07-SM gate prevents new state-transition maps outside authoritative files.
defect_classes.denominator: 3 authoritative state machine files; 0 unauthorized map definitions

defect_classes.name: Production stubs returning fabricated success
defect_classes.phase_closed: A7.7 (gate only — instances removed in prior phases)
defect_classes.fix_description: Gate detects return { success: true } or return { status: 'ok' } without conditional or DB call. No active violations; gate prevents regression.

defect_classes.name: Route files importing domain business logic directly (bypassing services layer)
defect_classes.fix_description: Gate detects imports from @/domain/* directly in route files. Routes must use services layer.

defect_classes.name: Duplicate workspace resolver implementations
defect_classes.fix_description: Gate prevents new resolveWorkspaceId/resolveWorkspaceTier/getWorkspaceId implementations outside canonical resolver.

defect_classes.name: New enforceWorkspaceScoping implementations
defect_classes.fix_description: Gate prevents new enforceWorkspaceScoping implementations. Legacy usage allowlisted in middleware/workspace-enforcement.ts.

defect_classes.name: Unregistered permission action strings in hasPermission() calls
defect_classes.prevention_gate: DC-12 in governance:scan:a77 (enforced by TypeScript type system)
defect_classes.gate_in_ci_note: Enforced by `npx tsc --noEmit` which IS in CI. TypeScript catches unregistered WorkspaceAction values at compile time.
defect_classes.fix_description: Fixed 4 missing hasPermission() action strings in decision routes. WorkspaceAction union ensures all strings are registered at build time.
defect_classes.recurrence_risk: LOW — TypeScript enforces this; tsc is in CI

defect_classes.name: Duplicate error sanitization utility exports
defect_classes.fix_description: Gate prevents new exported error sanitization utilities. Canonical: classifyOperatorError from @/lib/operator-error-governance.

defect_classes.name: New emitAuditEvent re-implementations
defect_classes.fix_description: Gate prevents new emitAuditEvent re-implementations. Canonical writer is src/infra/audit.ts. All 19 logAuditEvent callers migrated to canonical emitAuditEvent.

defect_classes.name: proof/review accepts body.requiredPermission (client-controlled permission elevation)
defect_classes.fix_description: Removed body.requiredPermission read from proof/review route. Permission is now determined server-side only. DC-15 gate prevents re-introduction.

defect_classes.name: asVerifiedWorkspaceId() called outside canonical-route-enforcement
defect_classes.fix_description: asVerifiedWorkspaceId() conversion is restricted to src/lib/canonical-route-enforcement.ts only. Any other caller is blocked by DC-16 gate.

defect_classes.name: File calls both claimWorkspaceId and resolveWorkspaceTier (claimed→tier poisoning)
defect_classes.fix_description: Gate prevents any file from calling both claimWorkspaceId (untrusted) and resolveWorkspaceTier (DB-verified) — mixing would allow claimed workspace to influence tier resolution.

defect_classes.name: Raw auditError in console.error without classifyOperatorError sanitization
defect_classes.fix_description: Fixed 3 routes (value, scenario, governance/alerts) using console.error(`${auditError}`) in audit .catch() handlers. Changed to classifyOperatorError before logging. Gate prevents regression.

defect_classes.name: Missing audit on decision creation
defect_classes.prevention_gate: DC-06 (no new logAuditEvent), DC-14 (no new emitAuditEvent re-impl)
defect_classes.fix_description: createDecision now wraps db.$transaction with emitAuditEvent inside transaction. Test: decision-creation-audit.db.test.ts.

defect_classes.name: Non-atomic status change with swallowed audit in changeDecisionStatus
defect_classes.prevention_gate: None specific — covered by audit pattern tests
defect_classes.fix_description: CAS updateMany + emitAuditEvent(tx) in $transaction. Test: change-decision-status-atomic.db.test.ts.

defect_classes.name: Zero audit + TOCTOU in PrivateModeRoleAccessService (4 mutations)
defect_classes.fix_description: All 4 methods (grant/approve/reject/revoke) now use $transaction with CAS updateMany + emitAuditEvent. Test: role-access.service.db.test.ts.

defect_classes.name: Version guard no-op in updateDeliverableReviewStatus (lost-update risk)
defect_classes.fix_description: version field now used in WHERE clause via updateMany + count check. emitAuditEvent moved inside transaction.

defect_classes.name: Audit .catch() swallowing failures on post-mutation audit calls (fail-open on write paths)
defect_classes.prevention_gate: No dedicated gate — requires human review of new write routes
defect_classes.fix_description: evaluate/route.ts .catch() removed from post-mutation emitAuditEvent. Pattern: read paths may .catch() (fail-open intentional); write paths must not .catch() (fail-closed required).
defect_classes.recurrence_risk: HIGH — no automated gate prevents new write-path .catch() introductions
defect_classes.denominator_verified: PARTIAL — no exhaustive re-scan done after Batch 15

defect_classes.name: Dead imports (getSession, resolveServerRole, role fields) expanding auth surface without purpose

defect_classes.fix_description: Removed dead getSession import from entity/route.ts and dead resolveServerRole call + role field from override/route.ts + OperatorOverrideInput.
defect_classes.recurrence_risk: MEDIUM — TypeScript doesn't flag unused imports by default; tsconfig lacks noUnusedLocals
defect_classes.denominator: 2 dead imports removed; full-repo dead-import scan not done

defect_classes.name: isDuplicateRequest imported but never called (dedup protection inactive)
defect_classes.prevention_gate: None — requires code review of route handlers using isDuplicateRequest
defect_classes.fix_description: Wired getRequestHash + isDuplicateRequest call in run/route.ts before expensive computation. Provides 5-second in-process dedup window.
defect_classes.recurrence_risk: LOW — run route is the primary idempotency surface; other routes don't need this pattern
defect_classes.denominator: 1 instance fixed; no other routes import isDuplicateRequest unused
